assumptions: Ideal 0-to-1 V step at IN relative to J1.3 ground
Nominal R1=10 kilohm and C1=100 nF, ideal components and wiring
No ADC or other load in this baseline; not a loaded-ADC acceptance test

ADC_dependence.interpretation: Both models are illustrative equations, not specified ADC models. Unknown Cs, Rsw, vs_before and s(t) prevent unique loaded response. No assertion that an actual ADC violates the band.

limitations: No component tolerances, capacitor bias/temperature variation, leakage/ESR, parasitic extraction, ADC load or bench measurement
The requirement is evaluated as voltage at 1 ms; no unstated stay-in-band or final-value settling criterion is imposed.
